run_lint_commit_all: run the lint_commit.py module with --all flag to apply black, isort, and flake8 on modified files
run_lint_commit_check: run the lint_commit.py module with --all --check to review linting issues without auto-correcting
run_lint_commit_repo: run the lint_commit.py module with --all --repo to lint the entire repository
run_lint_commit_path: run the lint_commit.py module with --all --path to lint a specific directory
run_lint_commit_selective: run the lint_commit.py module with --black or --flake or --sort to apply a single linting check
